public_adaptations: Final runner uses the active interpreter and resolves caller paths.
Poster builder reads a pinned research inventory instead of private Git history.
Public documentation, data manifest, downloader, release checks and tests are added.
Public manuscript author blocks omit the personal contact email; PDFs rebuilt from those sources.
The poster footer links to the public companion repository with a vector QR code.
Seven research integration tests report explicit skips when unbundled datasets/artifacts are unavailable; --require-external-data makes missing inputs fatal.
Public Git commits use the account-specific GitHub no-reply email.
